Featuring a heated swimming pool, this smoke-free hotel is a few steps from Ba Vi National Park. Nestled in the middle of Hanoi, the 4-star resort is near a national park. At the exclusive Melia Ba VI Mountain Retreat Hanoi, you'll be around a 10-minute ride from Den Ha. Also, the accommodation is 4.6 km from the K9 Historical Site. The air-conditioned rooms comprise an adjoining terrace and a balcony featuring an iPod dock and a television with satellite channels along with blackout drapes and an air conditioner. Along with a minibar fridge, the rooms are furnished with a writing table. Bathroom essentials include a bidet, a walk-in shower, and a separate toilet, and such comforts as a hair dryer and a shower cap. You can enjoy view of the mountain from the rooms. Those staying at Melia Ba VI Mountain Retreat Hotel can sit down to a complimentary breakfast. This Hanoi hotel features an American-style restaurant and a lounge bar. The restaurant serves European cuisine.
